name: Anais Medina Diaz
office: Rio Hondo Community College District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: Anais Medina Diaz has represented El Monte on the Río Hondo Community College District board since 2021. She directs communications for the San Gabriel Valley Mosquito and Vector Control District. Her district biography says she supported the Measure RH facilities bond and the expansion of dual enrollment. Her campaign proposes expanding early college programs, increasing environmental and science certifications, and growing student access to housing, food, technology, and daycare.
